## What this step does

Updates an existing narrative Quarto briefing so that it uses a newly published analytical package.

This is a **publish-layer task**, not part of the briefing analytical workflow. Start only after Briefing Step 3 has completed successfully and the approved package is present in the website mirror.

The current CVD pages are:

| Briefing | Quarto page |
|---|---|
| Incidence | `site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/case-incidence.qmd` |
| Case fatality | `site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/case-fatality.qmd` |
| Length of stay | `site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/hospital-los.qmd` |

Each page contains a maintenance note near the top describing the package-specific references that must move together.

See [The BNR analytics and publishing environment](../getting-started/environment.qmd) for why the Quarto page should use the **website mirror**, not private staging or the authoritative `$BNR_PUBLIC` package directly.

## Update the page

1. **Confirm the published package.**
   - Confirm the new `{briefing_id}` exists under `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/briefings/`.
   - Open its figures, workbook and ZIP before changing the page.

2. **Open the relevant briefing QMD.**
   - Read the maintenance note near the top of the file.
   - Identify the current package ID used by the page.

3. **Prepare the package-specific narrative snippets.**
   - Narrative snippets are stored under `site/_shared/snippets/briefings/cvd/{briefing_id}/`.
   - Create or update the snippet set required by that briefing page.
   - Check every narrative statement against the newly approved analytical results.
   - Do not carry headline numbers or interpretation forward without checking them.

4. **Update package references consistently.**
   - Change shared-snippet include paths to the new package ID.
   - Change every figure path and full-size figure link.
   - Change the workbook link and filename.
   - Change the ZIP link and filename.
   - Keep web-facing analytical links under `site/downloads/files/briefings/{briefing_id}/`.

5. **Update visible content.**
   - Change title, subtitle, year/category and date where required.
   - Recheck headline values.
   - Update narrative interpretation and limitations where the new results require it.
   - Update the citation and any visible reporting-period text.

6. **Check other formats.**
   - The current HTML pages link separately to PDF and reveal.js versions.
   - Confirm those links point to the intended version before publication.
   - Updating or rebuilding those separate formats is not performed by Briefing Step 3.

7. **Render and review the page.**
   - Render the site locally.
   - Open the briefing page and follow every figure, workbook, ZIP, PDF and slide link.
   - Check that no link still points to the previous package unintentionally.
   - Review the rendered narrative against the approved datasets and figures.

8. **Check site listings.**
   - Confirm the briefing appears correctly where the site lists Latest Data and briefings.
   - Confirm the public ZIP appears correctly on Downloads.

## Important boundary

Quarto presents approved analytical products. It does not own the analytical calculations.

Do not link the page directly to `$BNR_STAGING` or manually alter a generated analytical product to make the page look right.

If an analytical result is wrong, correct it through the appropriate Stata workflow and publish a new approved package.
